rationale: The benchmark candidate spans six canonical owners and eight source plus eight derived paths, changes product semantics and runtime behavior, and lacks deterministic propagation. This exceeds compact or verified-change boundaries and supports a non-authorizing structured_delivery candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
Brownfield analysis completion is not evidenced.
Stored quick_task context is not evidenced; compact_delivery requirements are therefore unmet.
Six canonical owners and sixteen total source/derived paths indicate cross-owner breadth.
Product semantics and runtime impacts are explicitly present.
Derived paths exist but deterministic propagation is false, excluding verified_change.
Baseline cleanliness and deterministic validation reduce execution uncertainty but do not offset ownership breadth, new/
derived-path propagation risk, and runtime/product impact.
This is only a benchmark eventual_delivery_path candidate and is not an operative Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
